en: Hey, hey, Doronjo-sama! It's finally starting!
Are we really doing this, Boyacky?
I've got a bad feeling about it.
Whaddaya mean, Doronjo-sama?
This here's our chance to make it big, I tell ya!
That's right, Doronjo-sama.
We've already sent out the challenge letters.
We can't back out now, yes indeed.
But Boyacky...
Yatterman alone is trouble enough...
...and now we're taking on every last good guy?
Are you serious?
Why, of course!
To prove we're the toughest villain trio in the whole series...
note: 三悪 = the villain trio of each show

en: ...Yatterman, Zenderman, Rescueman...
...Yattodetaman, Ippatsuman, Itadakiman, that whole bunch...
...we must take every last one of them...
...and give them a whacking and a smacking, if you please!
note: ギッタンギッタンのバッタンバッタン

en: Yeah, yeah! We're the toughest trio, the genius Doronbow! || We can't let them guys hog the glory forever, I tell ya!
note: one Whisper segment, split by length

en: My, even you, Tonzra? All right. || If you two feel that strongly, my mind's made up too.
I don't know how far we'll get, || but let's flatten those goody-goodies and steal the starring role!
Blasted Doronbow...
Then it's settled! Boyacky, Tonzra, get the mecha ready, and make it snappy!
Let's show the whole nation the true stars of the Time Bokan Series are the Doronbow!
Arahora-sassa!
Bokan to Ippatsu!
note: title call; the logo stays Japanese (D5), so the title is romanized

en: Doronbow!
Say, Boyacky...
...what mecha are we fighting with this time?
Hurry up and show me.
Oh, come now!
Really, Doronjo-sama, they're right behind you!
The Time Gaikottsu...
...the Skull Mecha...
...the Andromedama...
...the Time Rakuda...
...and even the Skull Buggy and the Denden Mecha!
Wow, Doronjo-sama, ya remembered 'em all!
But hold on, these are all mecha we used way back when!
Are you sure these worn-out old mecha will do?
These old bodies are just to put the good guys off their guard, you see.
Inside, I've rebuilt them into ultra-high-tech machines packed with the latest mecha!
Megaton-class super bomb factories...
...and energy shields that can stand up to any attack!
And of course they can go giant too, I tell ya!
No matter which good guys show up, we can't possibly lose!
They're that amazing?
Then I can't decide which one to ride!
Yes, each one has its own special features...
...so do pick whichever suits your taste, ma'am.
Doronjo-sama, it's done! It's done!
Done? What on earth are you talking about?
Looking at all the villains' mecha through the years, don't you notice something?
Now that you mention it, the other villain trios had machines of their own...
...but we never did.
Exactly!
Sad to say, of all the villain trios, the only ones without a machine of their own...
...were us, the Doronbow!
Hey, now!
But we had our ol' bicycle...
note: チャリンコ, the gang's old bike

en: Shaddap!
So I went and built a marvelous machine to match any other trio's...
...a machine all our own!
Now, allow me to show you.
The Genius Doronbow Special Machine!
The design is modeled on our own beautiful faces!
Not bad, Boyacky!
It's fresh and real slick, I tell ya!
Well then, let's use this new machine...
...to take care of the rest of 'em!
Boys, move out!
Arahora-sassa!
Look, Boyacky, Tonzra! || Their giant mecha have finally given up!
Yes, so it seems. || One more push and victory's ours, I tell ya!
Well then, shall we finish them off?
Extra-large final-showdown missile, ready to fire!
Come on, push it, Boyacky, hurry!
Oh, that's a little risky... No, Tonzra, you push it.
Ah, no thanks! This kinda thing is for D-D-Doronjo-sama!
Honestly, you're hopeless. || Keep this up and they'll turn the tables on us again!
Go on, Boyacky, you push it!
Oh, Doronjo-sama, you always make me do the dirty work!
Oh well, I suppose I must.
Well then, here goes!
Annnd... click! ...Oh my.
note: ポチッとな; his hand lands on Doronjo

en: What are you doing, Boyacky?!
Huh? Well, it's this little hand, see... it just went click, click on its own!
Don't use the chaos to cop a feel!
Oh! Annnd... click!
We did it!
We did it, yes indeed!
We really did it!
We won, didn't we?!
Boyacky, Tonzra, well done!
Let's drink to winnin'! A toast, a toast, I tell ya!
Then here's to the genius Doronbow's great victory! Cheers!
Cheers!
Still, that was a long, hard fight.
Oh, that's nothing. It's what happens when I get a little serious.
Oh, listen to you! || But this time you really impressed me, Boyacky.
Oh, really? Why, thank you kindly.
What is it? So noisy! I'm busy savoring our victory.
Huh? Wait a minute...
What, what, what is that? Boyacky! Boyacky!
Wait! Shoving me out in front... are you trying to get me killed?!
That's not fair!
Ahh... we lost after all, didn't we?
And we were doing so well, too.
I wonder if this is simply our fate.
If only I hadn't gone and said "a toast" back there... || It's eatin' me up, I tell ya...
Oh, it can't be helped. Quit your crying.
We beat their mecha black and blue! Let's hold our heads high!
Besides, Boyacky, Tonzra... I got to run wild with you two one more time.
I had a really good time.
Doronjo-sama... Doronjo-sama...
Anyway, let's call it good enough for now.
Without Yatterman and the rest, it'd be no fun anyway.
Shall we pay them back with interest next time?
A hundred times over, I tell ya!
That's the spirit, boys! || Next time, we come home in glory with a total victory! || The Doronbow will live forever!
Aye-aye, ma'am!
And so, everyone across the country, do stay tuned for our next adventure!
We're counting on your cheers!
Well then, see ya 'round!
We're geniuses!
Geniuses!
The genius Doronbow!
I'm Dokurobey, y'hear.
Those numbskulls get a loving punishment, y'hear!
Music, start!
Aaaaah!
